name: 19104 · Philadelphia, PA
findings: ZIP 19104 (Philadelphia) has 407 nonprofit organizations. 207 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 177 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19104 (Philadelphia) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
